name: MasterChef public setTrustedForwarder()
summary: MasterChef.setTrustedForwarder() is public, so the attacker became the trusted forwarder and spoofed _msgSender() through the calldata suffix to set pool 0's deposit fee to 100% and route the fee into the CRSS/WBNB pair.
